commands.command:
set -eu
ROOT=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
TREE=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/postmerge-main-reaudit-20261101-v1
DEPS=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/prod-map-intro-polish-20261101/frontend/node_modules
EXPECTED=373d45dbaa7fa18ca7d37f32c75b1808f17bbcd0
git -C "$ROOT" fetch origin main
test "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
test ! -e "$TREE"
git -C "$ROOT" worktree add --detach "$TREE" "$EXPECTED"
test -x "$DEPS/.bin/vitest"
ln -s "$DEPS" "$TREE/frontend/node_modules"
test -z "$(git -C "$TREE" status --porcelain)"
